title: SQL tests file
description: Schema for backend/src/seeds/tests/sql.json. Keys are question ids (as strings), values are arrays of test entries for executePostgres (PGlite).

input.description: SQL statement to be executed as the verification query (via runAgainstSolutions iterates each sol.tests). Typically a SELECT or a SELECT after a DML.

expected.description: Expected result.rows from the verification query. Array of objects or other PGlite shape.
